senses.sense_definition: Bijna moeten overgeven als reactie op iets wat misselijkheid veroorzaakt of iets wat in de keel steekt.

examples.text: De sterke geur van de rotte vis deed hem direct <w>kokhalzen</w>.

target_lang_translations.en: The strong smell of the rotten fish immediately made him <w>gag</w>.

examples.text: Ook de journalisten die getuige waren van de gebeurtenissen op de campus van UC Davis <w>kokhalsden</w> van de pepperspray.

target_lang_translations.en: The journalists who witnessed the events on the UC Davis campus also <w>gagged</w> from the pepper spray.

target_lang_definitions.en: To almost vomit as a reaction to something that causes nausea or something stuck in the throat; to gag or retch.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: to experience a reflex that makes you feel as if you are about to vomit
to make the sound and movement of vomiting without actually doing so
to undergo the spasms of vomiting without bringing anything up

senses.sense_definition: Een sterke afkeer of walging voor iets of iemand voelen.

examples.text: Hij <w>kokhalst</w> van het slaafse gedrag van zijn collega's.

target_lang_translations.en: He <w>is disgusted</w> by the servile behavior of his colleagues.

examples.text: Veel mensen <w>kokhalzen</w> van de hypocrisie in de politiek.

target_lang_translations.en: Many people <w>are sickened</w> by the hypocrisy in politics.

traits.comment: Figuratively used to express strong disgust

target_lang_definitions.en: To feel a strong aversion, disgust, or revulsion towards something or someone.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: to feel a strong sense of dislike or disapproval
to feel intense revulsion or moral disgust
to react with strong disgust or horror
